#1
इदं|idam|idam — this (nom./acc. sg. neut., referring forward to jñānam of the second line)
तु|tu|tu — but, indeed
ते|te|tvam — you (te: enclitic dat. sg. 'to you')
गुह्यतमं|guhyatamam|guhya-tama — most secret, superlative of guhya (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with idam)
प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे|pravakṣyāmi anasūyave|pra-vac — to declare, proclaim (pravakṣyāmi: future 1st sg. 'I shall declare'; -i + a- → -y a-);;an-asūyu — free from malice, uncensorious, not carping (anasūyave: dat. sg. masc., addressed to Arjuna)
--
ज्ञानं|jñānam|jñāna — knowledge (nom./acc. sg. neut., in apposition to idam, object of pravakṣyāmi)
विज्ञानसहितं|vijñāna-sahitam|vi-jñāna — realization, discriminative/experiential knowledge (first compound member);;sahita — accompanied by, combined with (vijñāna-sahita: 'combined with realization', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jñānam)
यज्ज्ञात्वा|yat jñātvā|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring to jñānam; -t + j- → -j jñ-, assimilation);;jñā — to know (jñātvā: gerund 'having known')
मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्|mokṣyase aśubhāt|muc — to release, free (mokṣyase: future middle 2nd sg. 'you shall be released'; -e + a- → -e with avagraha);;a-śubha — inauspicious, evil (aśubhāt: abl. sg. neut., 'from evil')
#2

--

#3

#4
